# BIRIM
> BIRIM is a contemporary design and furniture brand based in Istanbul, Turkey. We create furniture, accessories, and architectural solutions through collaboration with visionary designers.

## About BIRIM
BIRIM brings together modern design philosophy with quality craftsmanship. Our collections span furniture, lighting, accessories, and custom architectural solutions for residential and commercial spaces.
